text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Morning shift again today, Ines? I
feel like I
see you all the time lately.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, my boyfriend said
he saw you
working at some other
place...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yep! I've started another
part-time job.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, darn it. I've gotta get to class! Let's
chat
again next time we have a shift
together!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, okay. Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we complete our final preparations
for the
Kikuka Sho, something about
Ines Fujin seems
off...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a bleak expression on her face,
and her
lap time reflects her shortness of
breath.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a mediocre time—a far cry from her
personal
best. Attempting to suppress
her natural instincts
has caused her form
to become rigid...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't break out of this rut soon,
it might
have serious implications for her
future
performances.
choice_data_list: (...She's in a bit of a slump.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What's up, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You don't have to hold it back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been striving to help Ines develop a
new
running style because I believed
that was the best
way to address her
stamina issues.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if taking on that challenge is just
causing
more issues for her, we might be
better off going
back to her original
running style.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, I'm fine! Rather than worrying, I
want you
to sit back and expect big
things!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'll back you up to make up for it.
I'll be sure to back you up to make up for it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to show my family that I'll always
be
brimming with energy, no matter how
tough the
race!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Because I know those two will be
watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho has arrived.
Ines Fujin
has her eyes tightly shut, as if
trying to suppress
her excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh—someone's calling me! Huh? But this
number
is...

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Is this Ines Fujin? Where are you
at the
moment?

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
As it's your first day working with us, I
wanted to
give you a quick rundown of
your duties. But you
didn't show up to
the assigned meeting place.

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Um? Hello? I don't have the wrong
number, do I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry! I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'm—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's face suddenly turns pale
before my
eyes, so I take the phone and
speak for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In short, she accidentally scheduled a
shift at her
new part-time job that
overlaps with the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After apologizing profusely, we're able
to settle
the matter without it turning
into too big of an
incident.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer. I messed up...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing like this has ever happened
before...
choice_data_list: Ines, it's going to be okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Ines Fujin that I'll explain the
situation to her
employer so that she
doesn't have to shoulder the
blame
alone.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Take a deep breath and focus on the race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: O-okay... You're right!
choice_data_list: Show everyone how fun your running is.
Show everyone how fun your running is.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I've gotta redeem
myself on the
track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow behind her as she hurries out of
the
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shouldn't be left alone right now.
The least I
can do is wave to her from
the side of the
paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to do whatever I can to support
her, no
matter how small...
